thread:
Aisha Khan: Quick pre-cutover sync for Vellum private deploy — checklist items and a couple of last-minute blockers. Can we confirm firewall + KMS policy + audit forwarding before tomorrow's window?

Ravi Patel: I checked the SGs — app subnets allowed outbound 443 but we don't have the ingress from the health-checker IP range yet. list below.
Marta Lopez: Which health-checker IPs do you need? I have the VPC CIDRs and the proxy NATs.
Ravi Patel: Need these added to the app load balancer security group: `34.120.18.0/24, 34.120.19.0/24` (health-checker). Right now LB only allows our internal CIDRs.
Devon Chen: Heads up — during a dry run I noticed auditor role couldn't access CloudTrail bucket because the KMS key alias doesn't match the policy. KMS alias is `alias/vellum-prod` but policy expects `alias/vellum-main`.
Aisha Khan: Ugh — that'll block log decryption for Splunk forwarder. Can you paste the minimal policy change?
Devon Chen: sure — simple snippet to allow decrypt:
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowAuditDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodAuditRole"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Marta Lopez: We can also add an alias redirect so customers keep their naming. I'll add `alias/vellum-main` pointing to same key.
InfraBot: Automated check: CloudTrail -> S3 bucket encryption: OK, CloudWatch -> Kinesis: OK, Audit forwarding to Splunk: FAILED (KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR). Timestamp 2026-03-20T12:07:03Z
Aisha Khan: Thanks infra bot. Devon — can you make the policy change and add an action item in the shared runbook?
Devon Chen: Done. I pushed a line in the runbook and opened an IAM ticket to rotate the alias. PR: https://git.company/repo/infra/pull/482
Ravi Patel: Back to networking — Marta can you add the health-checker IPs to the LB SG and confirm NAT gateway egress for telemetry?
Marta Lopez: Added inbound rules for the LB. NAT gateway egress already covers telemetry but I found one routing entry missing toward the monitoring VPC peering for port 514. I patched the route table.
Aisha Khan: Perfect. Two more items: 1) retention window — finance requested 7 years for audit artifacts, current config is 1 year. 2) customer asked for a 1-hr enablement session for their security team tomorrow at 10:30 PT.
Devon Chen: Retention change requires bucket policy update + storage class decision. I'll draft the bucket lifecycle and estimated cost delta.
Aisha Khan: Please include cost delta in the ticket — renewal team flagged this as a potential finance objection.
Ravi Patel: Also flagged a perf risk: KV cache warm-up on first traffic spike could add ~300ms for initial requests. Recommend pre-warming during cutover window.
Aisha Khan: Noted — we'll schedule a 15-min prewarm step in the runbook right before the DNS swing.
Marta Lopez: Confirmed everything else — Splunk forwarder tested after KMS fix, logs decrypting now.
Aisha Khan: Awesome. Meeting invite sent to Vellum security + infra for 10:30 PT. Agenda: quick walkthrough (15m), audit+retention decision (20m), cutover runbook Q/A (25m).
Devon Chen: I'll join and share the runbook link.
InfraBot: Action summary added to thread: KMS alias fix (done), LB SG updated (done), route table patched (done), retention ticket opened (TKT-7821), prewarm step scheduled.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team :raised_hands: — next update after the enablement call or earlier if anything breaks.
